format: stands/15-scenarios (A4 modal: a page, probes in steps); the runner is tests/browser/manifest-probes.browser.mjs

probes.title: the heading is the page's h1 and the count a badge
star off and on draw a star in that state; absent draws none

steps.check: (() => { const off = document.querySelector('#h .sf-page-header-star button'); const on = document.querySelector('#h-on .sf-page-header-star button'); return off && off.getAttribute('aria-pressed') === 'false' && off.getAttribute('aria-label') === 'В избранное' && on.getAttribute('aria-pressed') === 'true' && on.getAttribute('aria-label') === 'Убрать из избранного' && !document.querySelector('#h-none .sf-page-header-star') && document.querySelector('#h').star === false && document.querySelector('#h-on').star === true && document.querySelector('#h-none').star === undefined; })()

probes.title: pressing the star sends sf-page-header-toggle {on}, then the dated sf-page-header-star, and the star turns on
probes.covers: events.toggle, aliases.json sf-page-header-star, keyboard Enter/Space (the native button)

probes.title: a host that cancels the request keeps the star as it was, and writes it itself
an install page says so in the element's language

steps.check: [...document.querySelectorAll('#h-none sf-badge')].some((b) => b.getAttribute('text') === 'для всех сайтов') && [...document.querySelectorAll('#h-en sf-badge')].some((b) => b.getAttribute('text') === 'for all sites') && document.querySelector('#h-en .sf-page-header-star button').getAttribute('aria-label') === 'Add to favourites'
